dslRule:
<!id: string.notTrimEmpty_to_notBlank>
<!description: Replace !String.trim().isEmpty() with !String.isBlank() for improved readability and efficiency (Java 11+).>
<!severity: HINT>
!$x.trim().isEmpty() :: sourceVersionGE(11)
=> !$x.isBlank()
;;
summary: Replace `!String.trim().isEmpty()` with `!String.isBlank()` for Java 11 and later.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
